title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: front-of-room display defaults to attendee view in Town Hall (GCC High and DoD)

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: No administrator UI policy or PowerShell/API setting for this Town Hall front-of-room default is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android town hall default presenter attendee view Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy Microsoft Graph configuration profile; town hall front-of-room default view admin setting. Read Rooms release notes, home/admin controls and Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy; none documents this default control.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Events policies > policy > Events optimized for a large audience reaches the event-creation toggle.
claims.quote: go to **Meetings** > **Events policies**. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... turn the **Events optimized for a large audience** toggle **On** or **Off**.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled prevents organisers under the policy from creating large-audience events.
claims.quote:
To prevent organizers with this policy from creating events optimized for large audiences, run the following command:
Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTownhalls Disabled
claims.fix: Append to controls[1].note: 'The Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy reference still labels this policy as preview.' The reference at https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamseventspolicy?view=teams-ps says 'Note that this policy is currently still in preview.' Do not change this roadmap item's GA phase.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The low cost rating is consistent with a rationale that includes purchasing a Pro licence for Android rooms without one.
claims.quote: cost: "low"; 'the cost is that licence for any Android room without one, plus communication time'. The standard defines low as 'indirect cost only: admin time, communications, training'.
claims.fix: Keep cost low but narrow its basis to existing Pro rooms: replace rationale: cost with 'Low. The feature is included in Teams Rooms Pro; for rooms already licensed for Pro, the indirect cost is communication time. No separate meter is documented.' In Cost and licensing, replace the last sentence with 'Communication time is an indirect cost. An Android room without Teams Rooms Pro needs that licence to use this feature.' This separates the product licence prerequisite from the indirect cost of this default change.
